subject.title: [Bug]: Session write-lock held beyond run lifetime when agent run fails during tool execution

question: Which open session-lock fix path should own the alive same-process lock-retention failure reported here?
rationale: The issue evidence says the lock owner PID is alive in the gateway process, while one linked closing PR fixes dead holder PIDs and another directly targets retained-lock teardown but has merge-blocking review concerns.

options.title: Consolidate around the live-holder fix
options.body: Review https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/100870, https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/89673, or a maintainer replacement as the canonical path for the alive same-process failure.

options.title: Retarget the dead-PID PR
options.body: Keep https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/100878 as dead-PID-only hardening and remove closing ownership of this live-holder issue unless new proof shows the report was misclassified.

options.title: Pause for broader lock policy
options.body: Hold all overlapping session-lock PRs until maintainers decide the safe reclaim policy for live but overdue OpenClaw-owned locks.

recommendation.title: Consolidate around the live-holder fix
recommendation.body: Review https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/100870, https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/89673, or a maintainer replacement as the canonical path for the alive same-process failure.

likelyOwner.reason: He is the strongest routing candidate from recent embedded-attempt/session-lock lifecycle history and original watchdog merge provenance.
